title: What happens to your trash?
description:
What happens to your trash after it leaves your curbside bin? Hear from City of San Diego Biologist Burton Ewert about how refuse is compacted throughout the day as part of the City's maintenance of the Miramar Landfill. 

Facts: 
• Nearly 910,000 tons of trash are disposed of annually.
• Spans more than 1,500 acres and is the City's only active landfill.
• Opened Dec. 7, 1959.
• Methane - a greenhouse gas produced as a byproduct of waste decomposition  - is captured and used to provide 90% of the fuel to power electrical generators at the Metropolitan Biosolids Center.
